options.description: List of configuration options to apply to ncal. Each item is a flat map of option name and value.

items.description: Not used directly, defines structure of list items in schema.

_comment_items_structure.description: Each item in the 'options' list should be a map with 'name' (string) and 'value' (string/number/bool).

options.value.description: Value for the option. For bool options, use 'true'/'false'. For others, use the specific value.
